name: fishplate
draw: Side view of two rail ends butted together with a long flat plate bolted across the joint by four bolt heads.

name: railroad-tie
draw: A single rectangular wooden sleeper seen at an angle, with wood grain lines and a rail foot clipped across each end.

name: rail-spike
draw: A long square iron spike with an offset hooked head, drawn upright with its chisel point at the bottom.

name: rail-fastening-clip
draw: Cross section of a rail foot held down by a curly spring steel clip anchored into a sleeper shoulder.

name: tie-plate
draw: Top view of a flat ribbed steel plate with a central rail seat and four square spike holes at the corners.

draw: Top view of a single track splitting into three tracks at once, left, straight and right, from one point.

name: derailer
draw: A small wedge shaped steel block clamped on top of one rail with a bright flag sign on a short post beside it.

name: rail-expansion-joint

name: switch-stand

name: balise
draw: Top view of a flat yellow rectangular beacon box fixed on a sleeper in the middle of the track between the rails.

name: axle-counter
draw: Side view of a rail with a small sensor head clamped to its web and a wheel flange passing above it.

name: trackside-cabinet

name: whistle-post

name: station-name-board

name: platform-number-sign

name: island-platform

draw: Side view of a small flat four wheeled trolley on rails with a push handle at one end.

name: rail-speeder
draw: Side view of a small motorized rail car with a boxy cab, a windshield and four small flanged wheels.

name: train-timetable

draw: Side view of a train carriage with a finger to lips symbol shown in its window.

draw: Side view of a train carriage with a large numeral 1 above its windows and a stripe along its body.
